subject: Data Engineering
title: Joins and Enrichment
description: A quick win: understand Joins and Enrichment.

hook.text: An order table has a customer ID but no customer name. A join connects the dots.

buildup.text: Joins combine rows from different tables using a shared key, creating richer datasets.

discovery.text: Enrichment adds context: appending geo data to IP addresses or currency rates to transactions.

twist.text: Bad join keys create duplicates or drop rows. A many-to-many join can explode your row count.

climax.text: Always validate row counts before and after joins to catch unexpected fan-outs early.

punchline.text: Joins connect data. Bad joins destroy it.

quiz.question: What can happen if a join key is not unique on both sides?
options: Row counts can explode from many-to-many matches
